department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Government of India

source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), Government of India
source_facts: The official DAHD National Livestock Mission page is the scheme-information reference. The directly fetched January 2025 operational guideline hosted by DAHD describes the central scheme across India and supplies the detailed component terms below: https://dahd.gov.in/sites/default/files/2026-04/NLMGuidelinesJan2025.pdf.

The directly fetched NLM guideline states general entrepreneur criteria: relevant training/experience/expert; either a sanctioned project loan or a bank appraisal and guarantee for self-financing; own or leased project land except group entities under separate criteria; capacity to operate at least three years; relevant KYC; and at least 10% project-cost margin money. The full activity-specific test still needs a named reviewer.

Guideline route: submit through https://nlm.udyamimitra.in/; State Implementing Agency scrutinizes and recommends, lender appraises/sanctions, State Level Executive Committee recommends, DAHD Project Approval Committee approves, and SIDBI channels subsidy to the lending institution. The guideline states 50% capital subsidy up to ₹25 lakh per unit in two instalments. Self-financing requires bank appraisal and a three-year bank guarantee; the first instalment is conditional on verified own expenditure. It excludes working capital, personal vehicle, land purchase, rent and lease costs.

The official guideline links https://nlm.udyamimitra.in/, but direct portal fetch returned HTTP 500 on 2026-10-08. The URL is an official application lead, not confirmation that the portal or a Maharashtra EOI is currently accepting applications.
document_review_note: NLM entrepreneurship is a capital project, not a general input subsidy. The full current document checklist depends on activity and State EOI; an empty checklist is not confirmation that no documents are required. Do not send KYC/bank files to Scheme Mitra.
application_process: Check whether Maharashtra’s State Implementing Agency has an open Expression of Interest for this activity and unit size. The NLM portal URL is linked by DAHD, but returned HTTP 500 on direct fetch 2026-10-08; recheck the official portal before use.
Prepare the activity-specific project and submit on the official NLM portal. The State Implementing Agency screens it and coordinates lender appraisal/loan or the documented self-finance route.

State Level Executive Committee and DAHD Project Approval Committee approval are required. Subsidy is routed through SIDBI in conditional instalments after specified contribution/project verification; it is not an automatic upfront payment.
